task: AI-guided inverse design of recyclable vitrimeric polymers with target Tg
named_methods: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation -> Tg (input only; provided in csvs)
Gaussian process (GP) calibration of MD Tg -> experimental Tg (heteroscedastic)
Graph variational autoencoder (graph VAE) over vitrimer molecules
Latent-space property optimization for inverse design
Validation of selected candidates (in this workspace: in-silico validation only; no wet lab access)
named_axes: MD Tg vs experimental Tg correlation
deliverables: EDA figures (Tg distributions, MD vs Exp scatter)
Calibrated Tg for all 8424 MD pairs with sigma
Trained graph-VAE with reconstruction & validity metrics
Latent property predictor (Tg) and inverse-design optimizer
Designed candidate molecules satisfying target Tg windows
report/report.md with methods, results, discussion, figures
deviations_explicit: Wet-lab experimental validation is NOT possible in this workspace; we substitute the GP-calibrated forward model as a surrogate and clearly state the limitation.

We use a smaller graph VAE (custom GIN-like encoder + SMILES GRU decoder) because torch_geometric is not installed and there is no GPU; this preserves the 'graph VAE' design intent while remaining tractable on CPU.
